sources_tried: Seeds file research/installers/raw/seeds/new-orleans.json: worked. Of about 40 map results, only Delco (Kenner) and Himmel's (New Orleans) were relevant. The rest were remodelers, stores and handymen. Partitions of Gulfport (Gulfport MS, distributor, no website) was skipped because it is about 65+ miles away. The web results were all Google redirect links with no domains.

ASI (americanspecialties.com/find-a-rep): 404. globalpartitions.com: host blocked (not allowed in network settings)
Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco/Ammco locators: not tried because of time and fetch failures
The Blue Book: blocked (403). Search surfaced only national firms (Knickerbocker Bathroom Partitions, NY, lists LA among service states; Partition Plus, MD), not local ones
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not reached

BBB category pages (new-orleans/partition, sun/partition, evans/partition): worked. They returned Exeter of Louisiana (Hammond), WERCO Building Specialties (Baton Rouge, distributor of partitions and accessories, about 75 miles away, skipped), Himmel's (Prairieville HQ) and Mississippi firms (Partitions Inc. in Byram, Jackson Contractors in Brandon), all out of area
onepointpartitions.com: blocked (403); known only from search snippets
wercospecs/werco-bsi.com: host blocked. businessreport.com article read instead (Werco, Baton Rouge, distributor, nationwide)
Ameri Glass (Slidell) site: empty page. Paul's Glass & Mirror (Metairie): 503
Scranton Tujague's New Orleans case study PDF: read; it names no installer

WebSearch: all 8 searches used (toilet partition installation New Orleans; Division 10 New Orleans; nearby cities Metairie/Kenner/Slidell/Mandeville; Blue Book; lockers/washroom accessories New Orleans; building specialties Harahan/Metairie; stall repair/ADA Metairie; Yelp). Results were dominated by One Point Partitions marketing pages, and no dedicated New Orleans-based toilet partition installer surfaced. The market looks thin: more leads probably need LSLBC license search, AGC New Orleans bid lists, or phone outreach to Exeter, Werco and Himmel's for installer referrals

candidates.name: Himmel's Architectural Door & Hardware (New Orleans branch)
candidates.review_source: BBB: A+ letter grade (Prairieville profile), no star rating or review count seen
candidates.partition_evidence: himmels.com lists 'Toilet Partitions & Accessories (Division 10)' as a product category and 'install & maintenance' as a company service; a Google Sites page about Himmel's (authorship unconfirmed) says 'installing a toilet partition, Himmel's has the certified installer to meet your needs on staff'. No partition project photos seen.
red_flags: Distributor of partitions (ASI and Bobrick are among its partner brands): direct buy-around risk
Partition installation stated only on an unofficial-looking Google Sites page, not on himmels.com
Mainly a door and hardware company
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 8/10 distributor with a New Orleans (Elmwood) branch. It sells toilet partitions and offers installation, but no partition installation is shown on its own site. It is also a competing reseller of ASI and Bobrick.

license.name: Himmel's Architectural Door & Hardware (New Orleans branch)
license.registry: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) public contractor search (arlspublic.lslbc.louisiana.gov)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. LSLBC search by company name 'Himmel' returned one record: HIMMEL'S ARCHITECTURAL DOOR & HARDWARE, L.L.C., Prairieville, LA. The detail record shows Commercial License CL.30245, status Active, effective 08/16/2024, expires 08/15/2027, first issued 08/15/1996. Classifications: Tower Construction, Carpentry, Limited Specialty Services. The licensed entity is based in Prairieville; the license is statewide, so it also covers the New Orleans branch. Company phone on the record: (225) 673-8777. To view the record, search by name on the URL given; the result opens in a popup, so there is no direct link. New Orleans has no local general contractor license for this work, since the city licenses only electrical and mechanical trades.

candidates.name: Delco Material Handling Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: The restroom partitions page offers plastic laminate, steel, solid plastic, phenolic and stainless partitions 'whether your project involves a new installation or a retrofit', plus layout planning and material delivery; it also sells toilet accessories. It never says that Delco installs them itself, and it shows stall photos with no project details.
red_flags: Describes itself as a partition distributor: buy-around risk
Installation by Delco not stated outright
Email is a personal-style bellsouth.net address
candidates.reason: A Kenner commercial specialties distributor (partitions, lockers, toilet accessories) serving New Orleans, Baton Rouge and Lafayette. It sells partitions, but its site doesn't confirm that it does the installation itself.

license.name: Delco Material Handling Inc
license.registry: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) public contractor search (arlspublic.lslbc.louisiana.gov)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. LSLBC name searches for 'Delco', 'Delco Material' and 'Material Handling' found no Delco Material Handling. The 'Delco' search returned only unrelated firms: Delco Construction LLC (Dermott, AR), Delco Contractors, Inc. (Keithville, LA) and Delco Services LLC (Thibodaux, LA). LSLBC shows only currently licensed or registered contractors. The company may hold no state license, or may be licensed under another legal name. Without a license it can do only commercial jobs under the state threshold. The company site (https://www.delcomaterialhandlingla.com/) gives its base as Kenner, LA and its phone as (504) 712-3388. It lists 'Restroom Partitions' as a service and mentions layout planning and material delivery, but it doesn't mention installation and shows no license number. New Orleans has no local general contractor license for this work.
